status: PROPOSAL for review. Not an engine export. Nothing here is implemented or validated in the running game.

frame.heading: Chassis heading h in radians, as in entities/rover/controller.ts: the front points along (-sin h, -cos h) in (x, z). h = 0 faces north.
frame.travel: The replay drive runs south (+Z) with the rear leading, so the chassis keeps h near 0 and moves in reverse. Recovery runs north (-Z) with the front leading.

Soft footprint: wheel trenches, berms, packed sand

vista.purpose: Coarse non-playable plain to the horizon; first ring shares every L0 border vertex

mesh.stitching: Each finer rectangle is aligned to its parent's grid lines and inset by at least one parent cell. Parent cells on the border are re-triangulated as fans to the finer edge vertices, so no T-junctions remain.

cameras.rule: Trails the direction of travel so the goal is up-screen: north of the rover while it drives south, south of it during recovery. Start from CameraRig defaults (distance 5.8, pitch 0.095, FOV 44) with yaw offset pi while reversing, and raise pitch to about 0.22 so ripple crests ahead stay visible.
